question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**suspend**" means to temporarily stop or pause, which accurately describes **what many students had to do with their studies due to disruptions caused by Covid-19.**
 
• "**Resume**" means to begin again after a pause, which is not applicable here as it does not capture the initial action taken by students during the pandemic.
 
• "**Reopened**" means to open again, and while it is related to resuming, it is typically used for physical locations rather than an action like studies.
 
• "**Carry on**" means to continue without interruption, which does not reflect the reality of the situation where studies were indeed paused or disrupted.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *More than 500 million students, at various levels, around the world were forced to suspend__ their studies. These changes have caused and will continue to cause some inconvenience, but they will also foster innovation and future reforms inside this education system.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Resume (पुनः आरंभ करना)**: to start again after a pause.
 
• **Reopened (फिर से खोलना)**: to open again, typically used for physical locations.
 
• **Carry on (जारी रखना)**: to continue without interruption.
